The same issue exists on Voat right now; essentially, if one toggles a post, the button changes to "toggled" from "toggle sticky". If you toggle it again, the button stays toggled (it does untoggle, but it gives no indication). A solution to this would to make a second toggle change the button to "untoggled", and then a re-toggle take it back to "toggled".

Next was a report about getting a 502 error when trying to post a vote on the preview. These happen occasionally, and since it is not consistently happening when starting votes I don't think it's a bug, at least not once related directly to votes necessarily, but until there is more information it is difficult to say.

There was a report about the navigation bar being messed up after the ellipsis change, which seems to be due in part to CSS (at least I have not seen any issues with it while having CSS disabled).

Next was a report about submitter tags not being applied to OP comments within anon threads, as it is supposed to. With the anon changes being made, it's good for such a thing to be caught.
